**Finding submitted: deviation (INDEMN, critical).**

- **Investigation:** § 12 is the only indemnity provision. § 12(b) gives TrueLink's indemnity but limits it to claims "arising out of any breach by TrueLink of this Agreement or any failure by TrueLink in the performance of any of its obligations" — no duty to defend and no IP infringement, breach-of-law, data-breach or gross-negligence coverage. Targeted searches ("infringe", "indemnif", "hold harmless") confirmed no IP indemnity anywhere else; §§ 2, 8 and 9 contain only Client-side warranties and a Y2K warranty. § 12(a) meanwhile imposes a sweeping Client indemnity (breach of Agreement, System/Credit Repository defaults, product/service injury).
- **Classification:** Fails fallback (no Vendor IP indemnity at all), close to walk-away.
- **Cure (preferred level, two surgical ops):** narrowed § 12(a) to Client Content and Client's breach of law (retaining that prong verbatim), and inserted a new § 12(c) carrying only the missing elements — defend/indemnify Client and affiliates against third-party IP infringement, TrueLink's breach of law, TrueLink-caused unauthorized access to Client Content or Credit Data, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct, plus notice, control of defence, and reasonable cooperation. No super-cap was volunteered (a fallback-only term), and the existing § 12 cap (Sections 3, 4, 7, 11 only) was left untouched so the new indemnity stays uncapped.
